subobjective.stem: Name five helpers in our community and what each does.
Say where four of these helpers work: doctor, teacher, police, farmer.
Name the two colours of our flag and what each means.
points: green for our farms and land

subobjective.stem: Mention four Nigerian foods and two clothes we wear on special days.
Name the two seasons in Nigeria and one thing each brings.
points: rainy season, with water from the sky
dry season, with dust and heat

subobjective.stem: Name four parts of a plant and what the root does.
points: flower — the root holds the plant and drinks water
